title: Log Changes with watch
short_description: Practice using watch to react to input changes and record events.
description: In this challenge, you will complete a component inspired by the watchers example from the Vue documentation.
The goal is to watch question with watch, update answer, and keep a small log every time the user writes a question.
instructions: Watch the question ref using watch.
Update answer depending on whether the text is empty, ends with ?, or does not look like a question yet.
Add one entry to changeLog for every non-empty change.

hints.title: Import watch
hints.body: The import can include both ref and watch: import { ref, watch } from "vue".

hints.title: Watch question directly
hints.body: Because question is a ref, you can pass it as the first source: watch(question, callback).

hints.title: Record an effect
hints.body: changeLog is not just a derived value for display: it is a record modified as an effect of each change.
